component.name: Balun
component.summary: A lightweight cross-platform HDHomeRun live TV viewer

description.p: Balun finds the HDHomeRun tuners on your network, keeps each device's channel lineup separate, and plays unprotected channels with GStreamer. It is a viewer, not a DVR: there is no recording, timeshift, or tuner administration.

ul.li: Discovers tuners on the local network and remembers tuners you add by address
Shows one channel lineup per device, with favorite, HD, and protected badges
Plays live TV with stop, volume, mute, and fullscreen controls
Talks only to your tuners: no cloud discovery, accounts, or telemetry

description.p: Pre-alpha development snapshot: local and exact-address tuner discovery, per-device lineups, and live playback of unprotected channels.
